Warranty and returns If it isn't right, we fix it. Every Zazu sold by us is covered by a 12-month Australian warranty through Coolkidz Australia, on top of your rights under the Australian Consumer Law. Faults are replaced or repaired; if we sent the wrong thing, that is on us.
Faulty or wrong item — 48 hours — Contact us within 48 hours of delivery. You'll have a return authority within one to two working days.
Change of mind — 30 days — Exchange or store credit, as long as it's unopened, in original packaging with manuals and accessories, and you have proof of purchase.
Manufacturer's warranty — 12 months — Against defects in materials and workmanship, from the date of purchase, on every Zazu sold in Australia.
How a claim works Three steps, no forms.
1 — Use the contact form with your order number, a photo or short video of the fault, and a sentence on what is happening.
2 — We reply within one to two working days with a return authority. Please don't send anything back without one.
3 — Pack it up and send it to Coolkidz Australia Pty Ltd, 1 Beyer Road, Braeside VIC 3195. The replacement ships as soon as it lands, and we transfer your return postage.
Questions The fine print, in plain English.
Do I get a refund or a replacement? — In most cases a faulty product is replaced or repaired. If you'd prefer a refund on a faulty item, ask and we'll arrange it.
What isn't covered? — Normal wear, damage from misuse or accidents, and batteries. Change-of-mind returns must be unopened.
My clock is stuck on green — Usually a settings issue, not a fault. Set the wake-up time before bedtime, and use the sleep timer if you need it back to red tonight. If it still misbehaves, get in touch and we'll sort it.
I bought it from a retailer — Go back to the retailer first, as the law requires. If you get stuck, get in touch and we'll help you through it.

faq.q: In short how do I operate Sam or Davy?
faq.a: Please check out our Quickstart video or read the manual. You can also check our how to video’s. It clearly describes the 1st steps to get Sam/Davy up and running. Once the settings are done, Sam/Davy will close their eyes every day and open them in the morning at preset time.

faq.q: If the power is turned off , does the sleeptrainer remember it’s settings?
faq.a: When the power shuts off, the sleeptrainer will not remember it’s settings unless batteries are inserted. We therefore advise to insert the batteries as back up in case power shuts off.

faq.q: How can I stop my child from playing with buttons and changing the settings?
faq.a: The clock will enter key lock mode automatically after 1 minute. To manually activate the key lock: press the key lock button for 3 seconds. After activating the sleeptimer/wake-up time the key-lock is activated straight away, so that the settings cannot be changed anymore.

faq.q: Can I separate the wake-up time from the alarm time?
faq.a: Yes, when setting the naptime or wake-up time, you can separately set the alarm. So you can set the sound alarm at a later time than the opening of the eyes.

faq.q: Can I switch off the orange screen, half an hour before wake-up?
faq.a: It is not possible to switch off or change the time it turns on. The time is fixed at 30 minutes. If your child is still sleeping, the orange light will not wake him/her up. But if he/she does wake up, she knows straight away that it is not much longer by seeing the screen is orange.

faq.q: How can I close Sam’s or Davy’s eyes?
faq.a: In the menu you select a time that Sam/Davy will automatically close their eyes every day. If you want to close them earlier you can press the DOWN button for 3 seconds and the eyes will close.

faq.q: How can I see if the clock is key-locked?
faq.a: In the top of the LCD screen the key-lock symbol will appear when it is activated.

faq.q: How do I know if my clock is activated?
faq.a: Sam or Davy is always activated. Once you have set the bedtime and OK to wake up time, he will automatically go to sleep every night and wake up every morning at the preset time.

faq.q: What if Sam is just not listening at all?
faq.a: Try resetting Sam by pushing the tiny button with a paperclip on the bottom of the clock. This will usually make him listen.

faq.product: Check our video on how to reset Sam/Davy
faq.q: Sometimes the buttons do not react when I press them. What is wrong?
faq.a: Probably the key lock has been activated. To unlock press the keylock-button, right, for 3 sec.

faq.product: Check our video on how to reset Sam/Davy
faq.q: If I do not want the alarm to sound, do I need to change the volume in the settings menu?
faq.a: No, that is not necessary. In the menu (alarm clock icon) you can switch the alarm ON/OFF.

faq.product: Check our video on how to reset Sam/Davy
faq.q: Is there a demo function to show my child the working of Sam?
faq.a: Yes there is a demo function in the settings menu. This demo will go through the entire bedtime ritual in around 20 seconds with preset time, so not the actual time that you have entered. You can check out our how to video for the demo function

faq.product: Check our video on how to reset Sam/Davy
faq.q: How long can I use the sleeptrainer when using batteries?
faq.a: When using batteries, make sure you are using good alkaline batteries. Also we advise you to limit the nightlight to 5 minutes and select lowest brightness in the settings menu. Only then batteries will last around 4 weeks with normal use. With other settings the battery life will be decreased significantly.

faq.product: Check our video on how to reset Sam/Davy
faq.q: I can’t find the off function in the naptimer menu, what can I do?
faq.a: You have to set the naptimer each time you want to use it, so there is not an off function in the menu because it ends automatically.

faq.product: Check our video on how to set the naptime
faq.q: Is it possible to set two wake up times so we can use a different wake up time for the weekends?
faq.a: No, this is not possible.

faq.product: Check our video on how to set the naptime
faq.q: What kind of adapter do I need for Sam/Davy?
faq.a: We advise you to use a 5V,1A adapter.

faq.a: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.

faq.product: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
faq.q: How do I switch on/off the timer for the nightlight?
faq.a: You can set the 60-minute timer by pressing the small clock and alarm button at the same time. Pam flashes once green when the timer is switched on and red if the timer is switched off.

faq.product: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
faq.q: Can I change the settings for orange and green light?
faq.a: This is not possible. The preset times can not be adjusted.

faq.product: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
faq.q: How do I switch on the wireless connection?
faq.a: Press the clock and triangle button at the same time. The wireless speaker symbol will appear in the display if activated. In the bluetooth menu of your phone, look for ZAZU-PAM and connect.

faq.product: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
faq.q: How long does the wireless speaker stay connected?
faq.a: If you use Pam with the timer, the bluetooth will switch off together with the light. If you use Pam without the timer, the connection stays as long as you are playing music/songs.

faq.product: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
faq.q: Why do I need to reconnect to the wireless speaker?
faq.a: If Pam needs to ‘look’ for connection 24/7 it takes up too much battery.

faq.product: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
faq.q: How do I change the colour of the nightlight?
faq.a: Press the big round button several times to get to your preferred colour.

faq.product: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
faq.q: How do I change the brightness of the nightlight?
faq.a: Switch on the nightlight by pressing the big button, then keep the big button pressed. The brightness will change. Let go at the right brightness. Pam will remember this setting for next use.

faq.product: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
faq.q: How do I use Pam as a nightlight only?
faq.a: Press the triangle button on the bottom for 3 seconds. In the display will appear a crossed out alarm clock. This means that the sleeptraining function is switched off.

faq.product: Press the big round ON/OFF button on the bottom.
faq.q: What kind of adaptor do I need to use for charging?
faq.a: You can use any 5Volt output adapter for charging. Most telephone adapters comply with this.

faq.q: HOW DOES THE CRY SENSOR WORK?
faq.a: The cry sensor operates by listening to sounds, such as crying. When it detects a certain level of sound, typically crying, it will activate the rocking. Upon detecting crying, it will rock the stroller for a duration of 10 minutes. The cry sensor will remain active for a continuous period of 3 hours to provide soothing support when needed.

faq.q: IF THE LED LIGHT IS FLASHING, HOW MUCH TIME REMAINS UNTIL THE PRODUCT IS DEPLETED?
faq.a: When the flashing begins, you can expect approximately 2 more hours of usage, contingent upon the chosen frequency.

faq.q: CAN YOU I USE THE ROCKER IN THE RAIN?
faq.a: The product has been tested with an IPX1 rating, indicating its resistance to light rain. However, we strongly recommend that when it starts raining, you remove the rocker and store it in a dry place. Please refrain from exposing it to prolonged or heavy rainfall.

faq.q: CAN I ATTACH THE ROCKER ANYWHERE?
faq.a: The product should always be positioned horizontally and should not be attached to the side bar. The ideal placement is on the main handlebar of the stroller. The farther away it is from the wheel base, the more effective the rocking motion will be.

faq.q: IS IT POSSIBLE TO KEEP ROBBY RUNNING CONTINUOUSLY?
faq.a: You cannot have Robby on continuously, as the rocker is programmed to automatically switch off after 40 minutes. However, you have the option to activate the cry sensor. When your child remains restless and cries, the cry sensor will automatically switch on the rocker again for an additional 10 minutes to provide soothing comfort.

faq.q: IN WHAT TEMPERATURE RANGE IS ROBBY SUITABLE FOR USE?
faq.a: Robby is suitable for use in temperatures ranging from 30°C to -10°C. However, please be aware that colder temperatures will result in reduced battery life.

faq.q: How do I close Bobby’s eyes?
faq.a: Press the big button on the top for 3 seconds and Bobby’s eyes will close until it is OK to wake up.

faq.q: Do I need to close the eyes every night?
faq.a: Yes, every night at bedtime you close Bobby’s eyes by pressing the big button on top for 3 seconds.

faq.q: How do I switch the sound off?
faq.a: Behind the lid on the bottom there is a knob with which you can lower the sound volume or switch off completely.

faq.q: What power supply does Brody have?
faq.a: Brody works on 3x AA Alkaline batteries.

faq.q: Is it possible to set two wake up times so we can use a different wake up time for the weekends?
faq.a: No, this is not possible.

faq.q: How do I use Brody as a nightlight only?
faq.a: If the display does not show the ‘alarm clock’ icon in the left bottom of the display, your Brody is ready for nightlight/soundmachine only. If not follow below steps:

faq.q: How do I change the brightness of the light?
faq.a: First unlock the key-lock before you can change any settings. Switch on the nightlight by long pressing the shell button. Then press the ‘light bulb’ button until you reach the preferred brightness (HIGH-MEDIUM-LOW-OFF). Check our how to video

faq.q: How can I turn on the lights?
faq.a: On the front of the nightlight you can find a big button. When you press this button, both the light of the owl/bear and the ring will turn ON. By pressing the OWL/BEAR button, on the left side of the little owl/bear, only the light of the owl/bear will turn ON. When you press the RING button, on the right side of the little owl/bear, only the light of the RING will turn ON.

faq.q: How can I activate the timer?
faq.a: You can turn on the timer function of the little owl/bear by pressing the OWL/BEAR button for 2 seconds. The owl/bear will flicker when the timer is activated. The timer function of the ring can be turned on by pressing the RING button for 2 seconds. Again, the light of the ring will flicker when the timer is activated.

faq.q: How long will the lights stay on when the timer is activated?
faq.a: The owl/bear will turn off after 60 minutes and the ring will turn off after 30 minutes.

faq.q: How can I adjust the brightness of the lights?
faq.a: You can find two sliders on the back of Lou/Billy. By sliding them back and forth you can separately adjust the brightness of the owl/bear and the ring.

faq.q: How does the cry sensor work?
faq.a: On the back of Lou/Billy there’s a switch with a small ear. Put the switch on ON to activate the cry sensor and switch it to OFF to turn the cry sensor off.

faq.q: How long will the owl/bear stay on when the sound sensor is activated?
faq.a: When your child is crying the owl/bear will stay on for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes the light will automatically switch off.

faq.q: How can I turn on the lights?
faq.a: With the ON/OFF button. Press 1x for soft light. Press 2x for bright light. Press 3x to turn it OFF.

faq.q: After how many minutes does the light turn OFF?
faq.a: The lights will automatically switch off after 60 minutes.

faq.q: How do I know my Fin is charging?
faq.a: When Fin is charging a small red light will light up. When Fin is fully charged this light will turn green.

faq.q: How long does it take before Fin is fully charged?
faq.a: The battery is fully charged after 10 hours.

faq.q: What is the battery life of Fin?
faq.a: A full battery will have a life of around 10 hours.

faq.q: How do I take off the silicone cover?
faq.a: If you squeeze the silicone cover and grab the light with your other hand, you can pull the cover off. If you know the trick it is easy. We have made it a little difficult so that small children are not able to take off the cover themselves

faq.q: How long is the battery life?
faq.a: For white light it lasts around 70 hours, for orange it is less around 45 hours. Orange light consumes more power than white.

faq.q: How does the twilight sensor work?
faq.a: The lights will automatically switch on when it gets dark and off when it turns light.

faq.q: How can I change the colour of the light?
faq.a: There is a small button on the plug if you take off the cover. Here you choose white or orange light.

faq.q: Can I switch off the twilight sensor?
faq.a: Yes you can switch off the twilight sensor. The light will then be completely off. To do this take off the cover and set the slider to the OFF position

faq.q: How long is the battery life?

faq.q: How can I change the colour of the light?
faq.a: To change the colour of the light, simply tap on the silicone bear and the light will change. Choose from 8 colours.

faq.q: How do I turn the timer on and off?
faq.a: Double click the button on the bottom. If the timer is ON you see a green light. If the timer is OFF you see a red light near the button

faq.q: How long is the battery life?
faq.a: You can use Suzy for more than 100 hours on 1 charge.

faq.q: Can I have Gaia switch off automatically?
faq.a: Yes, you can automatically switch off after 20 or 40 minutes. Set the slider on the bottom of the module in the right position. Alternatively you can play the entire night

faq.q: How long does the flash light stay ON?
faq.a: The flash light automatically switches off after 10 minutes. So your child will not sleep with the bright light.

faq.q: How long does the nightlight stay on?
faq.a: The nightlight switches off after 30 minutes. When Gina is charging, the nightlight can stay on the entire night.

faq.q: How do I change the colour of the nightlight?
faq.a: Keep the nightlight button pressed and the colours will change. Let go when the preferred colour is showing. Gina will remember the setting for next time use.

faq.q: How do I switch off the nightlight manually?
faq.a: Press the nightlight button and wait until the light switches OFF. It might take another few colours until you reach the off setting.

faq.q: Can I use the nightlight without sound?
faq.a: Yes, on the top side of the module you can switch off the sound and use the light only.

faq.q: How long do the batteries last?
faq.a: Depending on how many times it is activated it should last 4-6 weeks.

faq.q: How do I change the colour?
faq.a: Tap with your nail on the ring and the colour will change. The light will remember the setting for next use.

faq.q: How do I change the brightness?
faq.a: Keep your hand fixated underneath the light. As long as your hand is in the beam, the light will slowly dim and get brighter. Take away your hand once the preferred brightness is reached. The light will remember the setting.

faq.q: How do I switch it on or off?
faq.a: Swipe your hand underneath the light and it will switch ON or OFF.

faq.q: How does the tumbling work?
faq.a: You can switch on/off the light by giving the tumbler a small push. In between on and off the light might stand still for a short while.

faq.q: After how long will the light switch off?

faq.q: How does Emmy work?
faq.a: Emmy can help your little one to clear the mind by playing calm breathing sound and projecting light on the ceiling getting bigger and smaller. Your little one will automatically focus and follow the calm breathing and pulse light and fall asleep more easily.

faq.q: How do I turn Emmy on?
faq.a: To switch Emmy on press the round button on the front, between the elephant paws.

faq.q: How does the 3 step sleep program work?
faq.a: In the first phase the light is bright and orange and blue fish are swimming around the room, together with soothing sound, this to grab the attention of the baby. In phase two the brightness is lower and the orange fish disappear, a more quiet environment. In phase three the waves and fish stop swimming and there is no more sound. The perfect setting to fall asleep.

faq.q: How long does the cry sensor work?

faq.q: Can I use Wally without sound?

faq.q: Can I use the bag as a coolpack?

faq.a: You can play heartbeat sound, nature sounds, white noise, ocean sound, lounge music and 3 calming melodies.

faq.q: Can you adjust the volume of the melodies?
faq.a: Yes you can, you can adjust the volume yourself by pressing the volume button several times.

faq.q: After how many minutes will the sound turn off?
faq.a: The sound turns off automatically after 20 minutes.

faq.q: When will the cry sensor be activated?
faq.a: The sound sensor will be activated upon crying. This means that there should be a significant amount of sound. We advise to place the module within 60 cm of your child to be able to pick up enough sound to activate.

faq.q: Do I have to activate the movement sensor myself?
faq.a: Yes. The sensor can be turned on or off as desired.

faq.q: How do I attach Suzy to the crib?
faq.a: Use the red velcro that came with the product. You can attach the velcro on the backside through the loop.

faq.q: How do I select my melody?
faq.a: Press the shield as many times until you reach your favorite song.

faq.q: How do I record my own song?
faq.a: Keep the shield pressed as long as you are recording. When you let go, the recording will stop.

faq.q: How does the cry sensor work?
faq.a: On the side of the module is a small switch to activate the cry sensor. The sensor will stay active for 12 hours.

faq.q: When will the cry sensor be activated?
faq.a: The sound sensor will be activated upon crying. This means that there should be a significant amount of sound. We advise to place the module within 60 cm of your child to be able to pick up enough sound to activate. With or without the plush will make a difference, without plush the module will activate more quickly.

faq.q: Can I use Phoebe/Bruno without sound?
faq.a: Yes, you can. On the side of the module you find a setting switch which indicates light only.

faq.q: Is the soft toy washable?
faq.a: Yes, it is. Please remove the module beforehand.

faq.q: How long will my recording be saved?
faq.a: The recording will be kept until a new recording is recorded. The recording will be removed when you turn off the module with the switch on the side.

faq.q: How long do the batteries last?
faq.a: Depending on how many times it is activated it should last about 15 hours.

faq.q: How does the auto shut-off work?
faq.a: Zoe will automatically shut off after 20 minutes. Sound as well as music.

faq.q: How do I connect my phone?
faq.a: Switch the small button on the right side to the phone icon. The wireless speaker is now active. Check the Bluetooth menu of our phone and look for ZAZU-ZOE. Press connect. You can now play your songs.

faq.q: How does the cry sensor work?
faq.a: Press the cry sensor button, when activated the small LED light will light up. The sensor will be activated for 12 hours. It will activate the last played song.

faq.q: When will the cry sensor be activated?
faq.a: The sound sensor will be activated upon crying. This means that there should be a significant amount of sound. We advise to place the module within 60 cm of your child to be able to pick up enough sound to activate.

faq.q: Did not find your answers?
faq.a: Please contact us be clicking below. Then we can help you to find what you seek.

faq.q: Difficulties sleeping?
faq.a: ZAZU regularly writes tips about better sleep for kids and parents.

guides.title: White noise for babies: how loud, how long, how close
guides.summary: The short answer: about the volume of a soft shower, a metre or more from the cot, on a timer or all night at low volume. Here's why it works and how to set it up.

guides.title: A wind-down routine that takes ten minutes
guides.summary: Wind-down fails when it has no end. Here is a ten-minute routine that ends itself, so the end of the day isn't you saying no.

guides.title: Star projectors: do they help or distract?
guides.summary: Slow, dim and on a timer, a projector helps. Bright, fast or endless, it distracts. Here's how to tell the difference.

guides.title: Scared of the dark: what actually helps at two
guides.summary: Fear of the dark arrives around two, when imagination outruns understanding. You can't argue with it. You can make the room feel known.

guides.title: Why red light, not white, in a nursery
guides.summary: Blue and white light tell the brain it's daytime. Red and amber don't. That one fact explains most nightlight advice.

guides.title: The 2am wake-up: a decision tree
guides.summary: Hungry, cold, dark, noisy, or just awake? Five questions to ask before you pick them up, and what to do for each answer.

guides.title: Daylight at 5am: an Australian summer with a toddler
guides.summary: Summer light arrives before six. A dark room, a wake-time clock and a bedtime that moves with the season are the three tools.

guides.title: Davy, Sam or Sarah: which sleep trainer clock?
guides.summary: All three teach the same rule. Sam is the classic and the best value, Davy has plush ears and a nap timer parents love, Sarah is the newest and smallest.

guides.title: Naps on the go without losing the routine
guides.summary: Cafés, cars, grandparents' houses. The routine can travel if the three cues travel: dark, sound, and the same words.

guides.summary: Seven things that make a strange room feel like the one at home, and the two you can leave behind.

guides.summary: Shift everything by fifteen minutes a day across four days, not an hour at once. Here is the schedule for both directions.
